keeperTitle: rejects invalid enum values and identifiers from the telemetry envelope

    () =>
      createAppPerformanceEvent({
        routeGroup: "routine",
        operation: "proxy_auth",
        outcome: "success",
        durationMs: 1,
        correlationId: "lead_123@example.com",
      }),
    /correlationId/,
  )
